D/ ANTONINVS PIVSAVGGG[?PF] ; R/ PMTRPX VIIII COSIIII PP

Copper alloy Coin with black coating, possibly a silver wash. Base Denarius or Antoninus of Caracalla (198-217), issue of 216, cf RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 281. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS PIVSAVGGG[?PF]. Reverse description: Nude bearded figure, possibly Sol, standing facing with globe in outstretched left hand and right hand raised with…
